summary: Naver Place Search A (full-stack). A SERVER-SIDE Naver local-search boundary returns a small sanitized place-candidate list for an event's authored location — place-candidate search, NOT geocoding: credentials stay server-side, candidates are sanitized, and no candidate coordinate (mapx/mapy) is exposed or written anywhere. No DB/migration, no geocode_cache/pinned_transit_facts write, no feasibility change. Shared placeSearch.ts: PlaceSearchQuerySchema .strict (query 2..100), PlaceCandidateSchema .strict {title,category,address,roadAddress,description:string|null, naverUrl(url + http(s)-only refine), locationText} — NO mapx/mapy/coordinate/raw fields; response union + error codes (disabled|denied|rate_limited|unavailable|invalid_response|validation_error). Backend naver/place-search-config.ts: {provider:disabled} unless BOTH NAVER_SEARCH_CLIENT_ID + NAVER_SEARCH_CLIENT_SECRET are set (fail-soft default, no crash). naver/place-search-gateway.ts createPlaceSearchGateway: disabled→no fetch; naver→server GET openapi.naver.com/v1/search/local.json?query&display=5&start=1&sort=random with the client id/secret as X-Naver-Client-Id/Secret HEADERS (AbortController timeout, bounded retry only unavailable, STATIC errors — the request URL/credentials/Naver errorMessage never leave the gateway). Sanitizes each item → PlaceCandidate: decode HTML entities → strip ALL tags → collapse whitespace; naverUrl = item.link only when new URL protocol is http(s) (blocks javascript:/data:) else a https://map.naver.com/p/search/<encoded title+address> fallback; locationText = title · (roadAddress∥address); mapx/mapy are NEVER read (place search ≠ geocoding); cap 5. Error map: 401/403→denied, 429→rate_limited, 5xx/timeout/conn→unavailable, bad JSON/shape→invalid_response. routes/place-search.ts GET /api/places/naver?query=: validate→400 validation_error; gateway→200 {ok:true, data:{provider:naver, candidates:≤5}} | mapped error (disabled/unavailable→503, denied/invalid_response→502, rate_limited→429); registered OUTSIDE if(db) when a placeSearchGateway exists, NO DB/write; app.ts/index.ts wire it from readPlaceSearchConfig(). Frontend Today.tsx event detail: a 네이버 후보 action (shown when event.location ≥ 2 chars) → fetch+validate; placeSearch state keyed by eventId with the selectedEventIdRef stale-guard; states place-loading/place-quiet(disabled or empty)/place-error(sheet-local role=alert)/place-list of place-candidate rows (title, category·address, external 네이버에서 보기 link target=_blank rel=noopener noreferrer, explicit 이 위치로 저장). Saving (only on tap) PATCHes ONLY {location: candidate.locationText} via the existing /api/events/:id/thread-node route, then refetches detail + reruns loadGeocode + refreshes Today; viewing/opening candidates never mutates the event. cycle-77 directions + cycle-78 pinned + cycle-74 geocode preview untouched. .event-place* styles (semantic tokens, 44px). Tests: shared +5, config +3, gateway +6, route +5, frontend +5. Committed 3c9c228.
